newsitem.title: UK: Grand Met, Brent Walker ruling reached.
newsitem.headline: Grand Met, Brent Walker ruling reached.

text.p: Grand Metropolitan said on Monday an independent arbitrator had determined a downward adjustment of 117.5 million stg should be made in the price Brent Walker paid to buy William Hill and Mecca in December 1989.
The price paid was 685 million stg and Brent Walker had claimed an adjustment downwards of over 235 million stg.
Grand Met said the decision called for a payment of around 36 million stg as Brent Walker owed it approximately 82 million stg after a court judgement in 1991.
Grand Met said the amount of 36 million stg would be provided for in 1995/96 accounts as an exceptional item through an adjustment to the previously recorded gain on the sale.

The statement said that both companies had ongoing claims arising from the sale of the betting shop chain and Mecca, which operates bingo halls, but Grand Met said it hoped these could be settled without resort to further legal action.
